description: Official technical lane plugin manifest (vendor-neutral, provider-instance-backed): the node reads its providerInstanceRef and the runtime resolves the registered technical adapter, which computes indicator features (EMA/RSI/ATR) over the candles it fetches for the validated signal. No vendor logic in the node; deterministic. PRODUCER CONTRACTS (DEM-GOV §9). PLAN: a submitted afi.trade-plan.v1 is verified against the fetched window (levels within one observed-range width; stop/targets opposite sides of entry) and emitted as technical.plan; unverifiable → refusal (D-DEM-5(6)). Declared absences (D-DEM-5(4)(b)): no plan → no block; no stop or target → no rrToFirstTarget. CANDLE: over the same window, technical.brokeEmaWithBody (latest body closed counter-trend of EMA20; range: crossed it) and haFlatBack/haFlatBackConfirmed (Heikin-Ashi flat-back, seed (o+c)/2, epsilon 0, agreeing with the lane's trend law). No absence beyond the 50-candle floor.

candleLimit.description: Number of candles fetched from the price feed for indicator computation.
